title: He Wipes Away Every Tear
traveler_why: Tonight is about comfort given without a solution, and Willow the Warm is the Traveler who cannot fix her little cousin’s missing-mommy sadness and wipes the tears, hugs her, and sits close until she feels better — Isaiah 25:8 at a child’s scale.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she loves to comfort and dry tears. In Willow’s world today: Willow’s little cousin was crying because she missed her mommy. Willow didn’t have a way to fix it, but she gently wiped her cousin’s tears and gave her a hug and sat close until she felt better. Just like Heavenly Father’s promise to wipe away every tear, Willow brought comfort with her gentle, loving care.
